info.title: moonvalley/video-to-video
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "moonvalley/video-to-video", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for Moonvalley's video-to-video prompt route. A control video and a control type are what distinguish this route from text-to-video, and Moonvalley requires both alongside the prompt.

example.prompt_text: Apply motion control to enhance this video

200.description: OK - the provider's native result document, returned unchanged. Comfy has not described this model's output yet, so neither its shape nor its media type is narrowed here; the provider's own documentation is authoritative.

schema.description: Comfy has not described this model's result document yet. Router returns the provider's native output unchanged, so the provider's own documentation is authoritative for the response shape.
